super6.race: Irish National Hunt Chase CLG Beginners Chase
super6.comment: Off the mark in points at the second attempt but hasn't threatened in 4 starts over hurdles and looks up against it on chase debut.

super6.race: Careersinracing Step On Track Programme Handicap Hurdle
super6.comment: Veteran who got off the mark in a thin Uttoxeter handicap (2m) in May last year. Now 6 lb lower in the weights following a typically patchy run of form but in keeping with many from his yard of late, a couple of placed efforts of late more like it.

Fairly useful on the Flat. Showed all that relative speed as a juvenile hurdler and should have opened his account at Fontwell (demoted) in March. Hood left off and he produced a big career best when a ready scorer at Plumpton last week. Carries a penalty but this sharp test right up his street.

finals.race: PricedUp Bet Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Potentially well treated but he failed to justify support starting out for this yard at Stratford on return last month. Surely worth another chance given stable's record for reviving similar types.

finals.race: Irish National Hunt Chase CLG Beginners Chase
finals.comment: Off the mark in points at the second attempt but hasn't threatened in 4 starts over hurdles and looks up against it on chase debut.

finals.race: PricedUp Now With Best Odds Guaranteed Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Ex-Irish who has made a positive start for this yard, off the mark at the third attempt here (2½m) 5 weeks ago after 4 months off. Drop back in trip is no issue but 7-lb penalty makes her vulnerable up against capable bumper performer Seven Stars.

finals.race: Get The Inside Track With raceday-ready.com Mares' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Ex-French hurdler who scored readily on handicap debut at Hereford (2m4f) in March. Well below par when fifth of 8 at Kelso (21f, good to soft) following month but back on her game after 6 months off when a keeping-on fourth at Chepstow. Yard in excellent order.

finals.race: Careersinracing Step On Track Programme Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Little impact on Flat for Ed Dunlop but opened her account with plenty in hand for this yard at Wolverhampton in July. Hit the frame last 2 starts over hurdles without necessarily translating that improvement but she can remain very competitive at this level.

finals.race: Careersinracing Step On Track Programme Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Veteran who got off the mark in a thin Uttoxeter handicap (2m) in May last year. Now 6 lb lower in the weights following a typically patchy run of form but in keeping with many from his yard of late, a couple of placed efforts of late more like it.

Lightly-raced sort who got off the mark in points at second attempt in May. Made a winning start in Rules with an impressive success in a maiden hunter chase at Downpatrick (3m, good to soft) in May. A likely improver who represents a strong yard.

Changed hands for 70,000 gns and landed a Musselburgh maiden hurdle in February. Doubled his tally on the level at Goodwood in May and best effort yet over hurdles when second over C&D 2 weeks ago, a blunder at the last not helping his cause. Major player from the same mark fitted with cheekpieces.

finals.race: Fairyhouse Christmas Party December 12th Point-To-Point Flat Race
finals.comment: €62,000 3-y-o, Poet's Word gelding. Dam unraced half-sister to useful hurdle winner/smart chaser (stayed 3¼m) In Compliance and fair hurdler/smart chaser One Cool Cookie. Won sole start in points earlier this year and must be taken seriously on bumper debut.
